decisions.label: Least gap between sites (m)
decisions.note: The least gap, edge to edge, between a legend's circle and every other site that isn't a stump (the other legends' circles, the challenge circle's ground, home's dancefloor and treehouse), and between a stump's clearing and home's two (Ed, 2026-11-04: "Look at minimum distances between sites too"). Stumps keep their own: 40 m between them, and a legend's circle 40 m from a stump's middle. 25 m held on every map measured; bigger moves legends' circles on the maps where it doesn't. A new map: it reloads.
